sale_deliveries_coordinates_check.name: sale_deliveries_coordinates_check
sale_deliveries_coordinates_check.value:
(
        "sale_deliveries"."latitude" is null and "sale_deliveries"."longitude" is null
      ) or (
        "sale_deliveries"."latitude" is not null
        and "sale_deliveries"."longitude" is not null
        and "sale_deliveries"."latitude" between -90 and 90
        and "sale_deliveries"."longitude" between -180 and 180
      )

online_orders_delivery_data_check.name: online_orders_delivery_data_check
online_orders_delivery_data_check.value:
"online_orders"."delivery_type" = 'PICKUP' or (
        "online_orders"."delivery_recipient_name" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_recipient_name")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."delivery_phone" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_phone")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."delivery_address" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_address")) > 0
        and "online_orders"."delivery_commune" is not null
        and length(btrim("online_orders"."delivery_commune")) > 0
      )

online_orders_delivery_coordinates_check.name: online_orders_delivery_coordinates_check
online_orders_delivery_coordinates_check.value:
(
        "online_orders"."delivery_latitude" is null and "online_orders"."delivery_longitude" is null
      ) or (
        "online_orders"."delivery_latitude" is not null
        and "online_orders"."delivery_longitude" is not null
        and "online_orders"."delivery_latitude" between -90 and 90
        and "online_orders"."delivery_longitude" between -180 and 180
      )

client_delivery_addresses_coordinates_ch.name: client_delivery_addresses_coordinates_check
client_delivery_addresses_coordinates_ch.value:
(
        "client_delivery_addresses"."latitude" is null and "client_delivery_addresses"."longitude" is null
      ) or (

        and "client_delivery_addresses"."longitude" is not null
        and "client_delivery_addresses"."latitude" between -90 and 90
        and "client_delivery_addresses"."longitude" between -180 and 180
      )
